title: House Salad
notes: The house salad we build for our guests at The Village Table delivers a fresh, wholesome meal by incorporating organic mixed greens, quality cheese, locally sourced tomatoes and maple glazed almonds, tossed with our Honey & Beet Vinaigrette. The dressing is pure, sweet and unique. It is now bottled and available to purchase at your request. At The Village Table, we offer 3 varieties of protein to complement the salad. Our favourite pairing is with the blackened salmon. The sweet dressing complements the VT blackening spice on the salmon, producing a light savoury feast. There are different ways to glaze almonds. At The Village Table, we prefer to use a dry pan with high heat. Make sure you keep working the pan to keep the almonds moving. Once they start to brown, drop in the maple syrup and continue to work the pan until the almonds are well coated. Once they are well coated, spread them put on a baking sheet to cool.

methodSections.heading: Salad
steps: Wash, clean and dry organic spring mix.
Place in salad bowl with VT house dressing and toss.
Arrange cherry tomatoes around edge of bowl.
Evenly spread maple almonds & asiago cheese.

methodSections.heading: Almonds
steps: Toss the almonds in maple syrup first, then toast the coated almonds in an oven until they brown.
